name: AIAvatar
description: ZAIDYN AI agent identity — three concentric BRAND blue rings (#B4BDFF → #5A6DFF → #1F2A66) with white cross-star monogram. AIAvatar 34px, BotAvatar 18px. No orange gradient ring.
intent: Presentational fixed-color SVG. Same structure for both exports; only size, optional drop-shadow, and a11y differ. Do not theme-adapt fills for dark mode.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: size
props.hint: Diameter applied to SVG width and height

notes: Presentational SVG — no useId(), no linearGradient
AIAvatar: optional drop-shadow filter; aria-label ZAIDYN Agent
BotAvatar: no drop-shadow; aria-hidden when text attributes speaker
Fixed fills: #B4BDFF, #5A6DFF, #1F2A66, white path — same on light and dark surfaces

requiredAttributes: AIAvatar: aria-label on SVG (e.g. ZAIDYN Agent)
BotAvatar: aria-hidden when message text attributes speaker

forbiddenUsage: Do not use without AI context
Do not add orange gradient ring or linearGradient
Do not use useId() for gradients — component has no gradients
Do not theme-adapt ring fills for dark mode — use fixed BRAND hex
Do not use currentColor on circles or monogram
Do not invent sizes outside 34px and 18px without design review
Do not treat BotAvatar as structurally different from AIAvatar — same SVG, different default size
